issue.title: Fix early termination of search request with sort optimization

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
The query phase applies an optimization when sorting by a numeric field.
This optimization doesn't handle early termination correctly when `timeout`
and/or `terminate_after` are used. An IAE exception is thrown at the shard
level when the timeout is reached.
This commit fixes the bug, early terminated exceptions are correctly caught
and the result is computed from the documents that the shard was able to collect
before the termination.

Closes #72661

body: Yep so that's the bug, requests that timeout are not handled correctly on sorted queries. I opened a [PR](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/72683) to fix it, the workaround for now would be to unset the default timeout or to start nodes with the system property `es.search.rewrite_sort` set to `false`.
